ordered_diagnoses: Brain abscess due to bacterial infection

candidates.name: Cerebral abscess
support_spans: Noncontrast head CT demonstrated a hypodense area in the right basal ganglia with mass effect but no hemorrhage
Brain MRI revealed T2/FLAIR hyperintensity in the right basal ganglia and internal capsule with mild surrounding edema
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with a cerebral abscess

candidates.name: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy
support_spans: Brain MRI revealed T2/FLAIR hyperintensity in the right basal ganglia and internal capsule with mild surrounding edema
Repeat MRI demonstrated progression with new involvement of the left basal ganglia, increased diffusion restriction, development of necrosis, and new peripheral contrast enhancement
contradict_spans: John Cunningham virus PCR was negative
candidates.why: The patient's imaging findings and clinical progression are consistent with progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy
